# awscc_appfabric_app_authorization (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::AppFabric::AppAuthorization



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `app` (String) The name of the application.
- `app_authorization_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app authorization.
- `app_authorization_identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the app authorization.
- `app_bundle_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app bundle for the app authorization.
- `app_bundle_identifier` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) or Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) of the app bundle to use for the request.
- `auth_type` (String) The authorization type.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp of when the app authorization was created.
- `credential` (Attributes) Contains credentials for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential))
- `persona` (String) The user persona of the app authorization.
- `status` (String) The state of the app authorization.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to apply to the app authorization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenant` (Attributes) Contains information about an application tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp of when the app authorization was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--credential"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential`

Read-Only:

- `api_key_credential` (Attributes) Contains API key credential information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential--api_key_credential))
- `oauth_2_credential` (Attributes) Contains OAuth2 client credential information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential--oauth_2_credential))

<a id="nestedatt--credential--api_key_credential"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential.api_key_credential`

Read-Only:

- `api_key` (String) An API key for an application.


<a id="nestedatt--credential--oauth_2_credential"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential.oauth_2_credential`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) The client ID of the client application.
- `client_secret` (String) The client secret of the client application.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--tenant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenant`

Read-Only:

- `tenant_display_name` (String) The display name of the tenant.
- `tenant_identifier` (String) The ID of the application tenant.
